Definition: Perets, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Perets — Pharez — was the son of Judah by Tamar, who broke forth first at his birth, and the midwife said, “How hast thou broken forth? This breach be upon thee.” His sons were Hezron and Hamul, and Ruth's genealogy runs through him: Pharez begat Hezron, and the line runs to David.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God builds His line through a breach: Pharez was born in scandal and became the father of kings, and his name means the breaking forth.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
